content:
alex: CI is failing helm lint --strict for charts/inference when we apply the gpu overlay. Happens only in the merged CI values, not locally.
maria: can you paste the failing error and the values you merged?
alex: error from pipeline:\n\ninfra/helm-lint (step): helm lint ./charts/inference -f ci/merged.yaml --strict
Error: values.schema.json: schema validation error: additionalProperties not allowed in anyOf at path .gpuProfiles[0].resources

and merged snippet looks like:
```yaml
gpuProfiles:
  - name: v100
    count: 8
    resources: null
    nodeAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
        nodeSelectorTerms: []
```

maria: resources:null is suspicious. Is the overlay intentionally nulling resources? Helm's merge semantics can turn an object into null if the overlay sets it.
chao: yup. The chart's values.schema.json currently expects resources to be an object with cpu/memory/gpu; because overlay sets null the anyOf/oneOf validation fails. Helm lint's --strict runs openapi validation against the merged values.
jen: quick fixes: 1) change schema to accept null OR object for resources, 2) change overlay to omit the key instead of null, or 3) have helper coerce null -> {} before rendering.
sam: I ran into this before. We added a small helper for nil-to-empty-map in another chart. Example:
```tpl
{{- define "helpers.coerceMap" -}}
{{- if or (eq . nil) (eq (typeOf .) "string" ) -}}
{}
{{- else -}}
{{- . -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end }}
```
then use `resources: {{ include "helpers.coerceMap" .Values.gpuProfiles.resources | toYaml | indent 4 }}`

alex: hmm that helper cheats if typeOf returns string for templating edgecases. Any thoughts on deep merge? Our overlay uses kustomize-style patches which sometimes set null intentionally to mean "delete".
chao: deep merge isn't trivial in Helm templates. Sprig provides `merge` but it shallowly merges maps. We mostly just need to guard against nulls at render time. Schema should be tolerant though — accepting null explicitly is clearer.
infra-bot: CI job log excerpt:\n\n2025-10-27T14:02:10Z helm lint step failed
Error: values.schema.json: schema validation error: additionalProperties not allowed in anyOf at /gpuProfiles/0/resources
See https://helm.sh/docs/topics/chart_best_practices/values_schema/

maria: proposed schema change:
```json
"resources": {"anyOf": [{"type":"object"}, {"type":"null"}], "description": "CPU/memory/gpu resource defaults or null to skip"}
```
jen: that should silence lint. Also add a unit in chart-tests: create a ci/values-null.yaml that sets resources: null and ensure `helm template --validate` passes.
sam: alternative pipeline workaround: use `yq` to remove null keys before running helm lint: `yq 'del(.. | select(tag == "!!null"))' ci/merged.yaml > ci/merged-sanitized.yaml` then lint that. But that's a bandaid.
alex: I prefer schema + helper. I'll open a PR that updates values.schema.json to accept null and add helpers.coerceMap + template usage where we render resources. Also add a chart-tests case and a CI step to run `yq` sanitizer as a fallback.
chao: please also add a short comment in the overlay docs: "Use omit to leave defaults, avoid explicit null unless you want deletion behavior". We've had teams accidentally nulling maps to opt out and it bites them during lint.
jen: +1. If you ping me I'll review the schema change and tests.
alex: thanks — will PR in ~30m and link here.

(quick note: keeping this small — anyone else hit similar helm-anyOf/null friction in other charts?)
